meta.prompt_source: 英语二大作文 Part B（图表作文：某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比，用户转述）

band.rationale: 对照第2节档位描述，本文"基本完成了试题规定的任务"：描述图表与给出评论两个内容要点均覆盖，三项数据全部给出。"应用的语法结构和词汇能满足任务的需求"，但"有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解"（does not provides、volunteer activities is、percentage 连用错三次、拼写 phenomonon、逗号粘连、the the 重复）；"采用简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰"（Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion，三段结构完整）。未达第四档：其错误多为基础结构错误，而非"只有在试图使用较复杂结构或较高级词汇时才有个别错误"；远高于第二档：错误并不"影响了对写作内容的理解"。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三项数据（35%/45%/20%）全部覆盖且数值准确，describe the chart 部分完成；但描述停留在逐条罗列，无任何概括或对比（如指出 1-2 次占大头），首句 the situation of students taking part in 主题表述含混。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities
dimensions.deduction_reason: 两条原因与建议各只有一句话，无例证、无数据引用、无深入展开；评论 In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students 论点笼统，benefit 仅 learn skill and make friend 一句带过。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: There are many reasons for this phenomonon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ... In my opinion, ... Only in this way can we grow up better.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 描述—原因—建议三段结构完整，Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion/Only in this way 衔接简单但清晰；扣分点：..., many students don't know how to join 逗号粘连破坏句间逻辑，段落内部推进依赖并列堆叠。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: the school does not provides enough information; volunteer activities is good for students; balance the the study and volunteer work
dimensions.deduction_reason: 基础错误密度较高：三单否定 does not provides、主谓一致 activities is、逗号粘连、重复词 the the，三段均有错误；好在有 while 对比句与 Only in this way can we 倒装，且错误不影响理解。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students; It can help us learn skill and make friend; grow up better
dimensions.deduction_reason: percent/percentage 之辨连错三次，是全文最显眼的词汇错误；learn skill and make friend 可数名词未复数、take part in one to two times 搭配断裂、grow up better 偏中式；用词面窄（join/take part in/good/better 反复）。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university. ... In my opinion, ... Only in this way can we grow up better.

consistency.adjustments: 初评切题 4、词汇 1、内容 1.5 时维度和为 10.5，超出第三档上限 9，回第 3 步调整：图表描述仅罗列无概括，切题 4→3.5；percentage 三次误用为核心可见词汇错误，词汇 1→0.5；两条原因与建议均无展开，内容 1.5→1。调整后 3.5+1+1.5+1+0.5+1=8.5 ∈ [7,9]，校验通过。另：字数 135 为建议下限 150 的 90%（length_status=soft_ok），按第 4.3 条属小幅不足，不机械罚分，仅提示：末段可再补一句具体建议即可达标。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: the situation of students taking part in 表述含混，未点明图表主题是"每月参加志愿服务的次数分布"，语法上成立但信息不聚焦。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities every month.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: 数值后应用 percent（percentage 是名词"百分比"，不接在数词后），本句连错两处；take part in one to two times 搭配断裂，take part in 后缺宾语。
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of the students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them do so one or two times every month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 20 percentage students 应为 20 percent of the students；join 后缺宾语，应为 join in such activities。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students join in such activities three times or more.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写错误，应为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
sentence_edits.issue: think 后的 study 作名词缺限定、读起来生硬，更自然是 studying 或 that studying；拿不准降级为 awkward。
sentence_edits.revised: Firstly, some students think that studying is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: does not 后动词须用原形 provide；两个独立句用逗号连接属逗号粘连，应加连词 so 或拆为两句；join 缺宾语。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students don't know how to join in.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主谓一致：volunteer activities 为复数，be 动词应为 are。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: 可数名词须用复数：learn skills and make friends；句首 It 指代复数 activities 也不顺，宜改为 They。
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: the 重复（与预检 repeated_word 标记一致）；balance the study 冠词多余，应为 balance study and ... 或 balance their studies and ...。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more chances and students should balance study and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: 倒装句式本身用得正确；但 grow up 多指小孩长大成人，用于大学生"发展得更好"偏中式直译。
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we make the most of our university life.

improved_version:
The chart illustrates how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities every month. According to the chart, 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, while 45 percent do so one or two times a month. Only 20 percent join in such activities three times or more.

Several factors may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students believe that studying matters more than anything else, so they spend almost all their time in the library. Secondly, the university does not provide adequate information about volunteer programs, and as a result, many students simply do not know how to get involved.

In my opinion, volunteer work benefits students in many ways: it helps us pick up practical skills, make new friends and develop a sense of responsibility. Therefore, the university should offer more opportunities, and students should learn to balance study with volunteer work. Only in this way can we make the most of our university life.
top_problems: 基础语法错误密度高且遍布三段：does not provides、volunteer activities is、learn skill and make friend、逗号粘连、the the，是最压分的一项
核心词汇反复误用：percent/percentage 连错三次，take part in one to two times、grow up better 搭配不当，直接拉低词汇维度
图表描述与论证都停在"一句话"层面：数据只罗列不概括对比，两条原因与建议均无展开，内容深度不足
practice_advice: 把图表数据句练成固定句型：每天默写三遍 "X percent of the students + 动词 + 次数 + a month"（如 45 percent of the students participate once or twice a month），并对照改正本篇的 percentage 误用与主谓一致错误，一周内即可清零这类高频小错。

patterns: The chart illustrates how often ... every month.
According to the chart, X percent of ..., while Y percent ...
Several factors may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
In my opinion, ... The university should ..., and students should ...
Only in this way can we ... (倒装)
words: take part in / participate in volunteer activities
X percent of the students（区别于 percentage）
provide adequate information / offer more opportunities
